[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 300
- Description: Multi-attachment ordered pairing (contract A) — dao_protocol #164/#165 + prod deploy; autopilot git-auth root-cause fix; follow-ups #1082
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dao_protocol/pull/164
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/dao_protocol/pull/165
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1082
  
  Details:
  Worked thread 28504 (supervised by Gary Teh, who chose design **A — ordered pairing**).
  
  **Feature: multi-attachment submissions, end-to-end (contract A).**
  - PR1 — `dao_protocol` #164 (client half): `truesight_dao_client/edgar_client.py` — `submit()` now accepts `str | list[str]` and emits ONE repeated `attachment` part per file, in order; `build_event_cli()` `--attachment` is repeatable (`action="append"`); multi-file fails fast unless file count == github destination-URL count (counted under Destination labels only). Single-file behaviour byte-for-byte unchanged. New `tests/test_multi_attachment.py` (6 tests).
  - PR2 — `dao_protocol` #165 (server half): `server/routes/dao.py` reads `form.getlist("attachment")`; new additive `server/services/github_upload.py::upload_all_if_referenced()` uploads ordered file k → the k-th github destination URL (fewer URLs than files → hard fail, no mis-filing). Single-part path unchanged (back-compat proven by the existing `test_deferred_gaps.py`). New `tests/test_multi_attachment_server.py` (7 tests).
  - Key constraint discovered: `normalized_attrs` dedupes by label, so the pairing key is the ORDER of github destination URLs, not repeated Destination labels.
  
  **Production deploy + verification.**
  - Deployed merged `main` to the `dao-protocol` box (`edgar.truesight.me`, 98.93.94.86): `git pull --ff-only` `3b42488 → 3bb3853` + `systemctl restart truesight-dao-protocol.service`. Editable install, but a route-body change required the restart.
  - Verified: `/ping` reports `version=3bb3853`; public `edgar.truesight.me/ping` 200; live route has `getlist`/`upload_all_if_referenced`; smoke POST with two repeated `attachment` parts → HTTP 200 through the nginx→uvicorn stack.
  - Logged to the deploy ledger (`deploy_20260913T185329Z_dao-protocol-edgar-truesight-me`) and rebuilt the feed index.
  
  **Bug fixed: autopilot box could not `git push`.**
  - Root cause: `~/.gitconfig` carried a `[credential "https://github.com"]` section (`!/usr/bin/gh auth git-credential`) plus an empty reset line that SHADOWED the canonical `scripts/git-credential-sophia.sh` that `deploy.sh` provisions. gh's helper returns nothing when git invokes it → interactive-prompt ENOENT. (Read-only `git ls-remote` hid the bug because `dao_protocol` is public.)
  - Fixed box-locally (backup kept); verified push dry-run succeeds with no override.
  
  **Follow-ups filed** — `agentic_ai_context` #1082: git-auth shadowing (durable deploy.sh fix), `dao_protocol` has no CD (prod silently ran 2 commits stale; `/ping`-vs-`main` drift check proposed), and deploy-ledger feed-rebuild guidance.
  
  All PRs merged; all four local gates (compileall / ruff check / ruff format --check / pytest) green before each push.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 500.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
